description: This file defines an abstract class 'TableWithData' that extends 'Table' and manages data cells within a GUI table component, including data manipulation, interpolation, rendering, and file I/O operations for ECU data tables.

classes.name: TableWithData
classes.description: An abstract class for managing and manipulating data tables in a GUI, supporting data editing, interpolation, rendering, and file saving/loading.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets the data array for the table.

methods.name: getDataCell
methods.description: Retrieves a specific DataCell at the given index.

methods.name: horizontalInterpolate
methods.description: Performs linear interpolation between selected data points.

methods.name: selectCellAt
methods.description: Selects a cell at the specified y-coordinate.

methods.name: getFrameSize
methods.description: Calculates and returns the GUI frame size based on data and layout parameters.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Increments the value of selected data cells if user permissions allow.

methods.name: multiply
methods.description: Multiplies the value of selected data cells if user permissions allow.

methods.name: addKeyListener
methods.description: Adds a KeyListener to the table and its data cells.

methods.name: drawTable
methods.description: Draws each data cell in the table.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Serializes the data table into a byte array for saving, considering user permissions and data type.

methods.name: populateTable
methods.description: Populates data cells from a byte array input, decoding float or integer values.
